description: This file defines the JsonResponse class, a subclass of Response, used to create JSON HTTP responses with configurable payload, headers, and encoding options. It handles JSON encoding, error checking, and response body creation.

classes.name: JsonResponse
classes.description: A class for creating HTTP responses with JSON-encoded payloads, extending the Response class and providing methods for payload management and JSON encoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a JsonResponse with data, status, headers, and encoding options, encoding the data to JSON and setting the response body.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Returns a new JsonResponse instance with the specified payload.

methods.name: getEncodingOptions
methods.description: Returns the current JSON encoding options.

methods.name: withEncodingOptions
methods.description: Returns a new JsonResponse instance with the specified encoding options.

methods.name: createBodyFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Stream object from a JSON string to be used as the response body.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes data to JSON, throws exception on error, and handles resource validation.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload data, cloning objects if necessary.

methods.name: updateBodyFor
methods.description: Creates a new JsonResponse with an updated body based on the current payload and encoding options.
